blocks.orig: Kisiwa on the Beach lies on the stunning white sandy beach of Zanzibar’s southeast coast, ideally secluded near the charming village of Paje. It has 22 well-appointed private sea-view villas, that open to a balcony with furniture and are equipped with all amenities one needs for a beach holiday. Nestled amidst tropical gardens and white powdery beaches, the hotel offers its guests the opportunity to experience a lovely barefoot luxury, enhanced by a spa with two treatment rooms. Last but not least, delicious meals can be enjoyed at Bembe, the al-fresco restaurant overseeing the main pool and the Indian Ocean.
blocks.html: On the beautiful white sandy beach of Zanzibar’s southeast coast, Kisiwa on the Beach enjoys a secluded spot near the charming village of Paje. Its 22 well-equipped private sea-view villas open onto a furnished balcony and have every amenity you need for a beach holiday. Set among tropical gardens and white powdery sand, the hotel lets you enjoy relaxed barefoot luxury, with a spa offering two treatment rooms. And finally, you can enjoy tasty meals at Bembe, the al-fresco restaurant that looks out over the main pool and the Indian Ocean.
